Each finished job EARNS its message (graceQueueLite `JOB_EVENTS`): Correct a testimony → `mentor`; The places list → `arrival` (Orla, with `stamp` in the same thread); Return the family calls → `decision` (Mam); Post to the group → `job` (the check-in she posted); her 2014 record closed → `nuala`; Malta → `after`.
